BiblicalUsage: Pispah is named once, in 1 Chronicles 7:38, as a son of Jether of the tribe of Asher, listed among his brothers Jephunneh and Ara. Nothing more is told of him; his name survives in the genealogy, and that is enough.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe no name in God's record is wasted, even when the story is only one line.
